name: Okaizumi Haruto
source: An honor and third-year student who is also the Astro Circle's president and likes puzzles. He tends to yell whenever he gets too excited, which always frightens [url=/c3932]Komomo[/url] and results to the Astro Circle members handing him his puzzle rings in order to calm him down.
